albums.title: May 6, 2026 · Seminar on 3D Measurement and AI-driven Digital Twins in Construction
albums.description: May 6, 2026, 14:00–17:00 · Engineering Hall 1, A205, Yonsei University. Under the theme “Bridging Academic Innovations with Industrial Perspectives,” researchers from the University of Freiburg, Fraunhofer IPM, Yonsei University, and industry shared work on 3D measurement and data capture, AI and digital twins in construction and infrastructure, and practical applications.
